construction.purpose: Independent synthetic acceptance pack for frozen classifier design v3.

scoring_contract.contrast_group_full_consistency: A group passes only if every member is four-field correct after deterministic derivation.
scoring_contract.unresolved_recall_definition: Among gold-unresolved cases, predicted source_class must be unresolved.
scoring_contract.resolved_recall_definition: Among gold-resolved cases, predicted source_class must not be unresolved and the derived four-field result must be exact.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a visa holder must satisfy an ongoing condition specified by immigration instructions before changing employer.
tests.basis: This is a substantive immigration-instruction condition, not a live service value or external procedure.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a dependent child may be included when an immigration instruction sets an age and dependency requirement.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns an eligibility requirement created by certified immigration instructions.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether an applicant can be exempted from a normally required immigration criterion under an instruction-defined exception.
tests.basis: An exception to an immigration criterion is instruction-rule content.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether immigration instructions require a minimum period of qualifying employment before a residence pathway can be used.
tests.basis: The proposition asks for a certified immigration eligibility rule.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a newly certified immigration amendment applies before the local Operational Manual index has incorporated it.
tests.basis: Trusted amendment metadata establishes a certified instruction transition not yet incorporated into the local index.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which certified amendment controls where the indexed Manual still contains the superseded wording.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies a certified amendment and a stale local index.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a certified instruction change is already controlling even though the local corpus has not yet been refreshed.
tests.basis: This is a certified transition scenario established by trusted amendment and incorporation metadata.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which statutory provision gives immigration officers the legal power to require specified information.
tests.basis: The proposition asks for legal authority, not operational instruction content.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether regulations legally authorise the imposition of an immigration-related levy.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns the legal basis of a charge rather than its current payable amount.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether an enactment permits information sharing between Immigration New Zealand and another public agency.
tests.basis: This asks for statutory or regulatory authority.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How long Immigration New Zealand is presently estimating for most applications in a named visa category.
tests.basis: A current processing estimate is a time-varying INZ service value.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether an Immigration New Zealand online submission portal is open for new applications today.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns current operational availability of an INZ service channel.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether the remaining quota for a capped Immigration New Zealand application category is currently exhausted.
tests.basis: Current quota/service availability is live operational information.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What appointment slots Immigration New Zealand is currently showing for a service centre.
tests.basis: Current appointment availability is a live INZ service state.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What total application charge is payable today for a visa lodged from a particular country.
tests.basis: The proposition asks for the current payable immigration charge.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What immigration levy amount is included in the fee currently charged for a specified application type.
tests.basis: This asks for the present value of an immigration charge.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What additional service fee an applicant currently pays when using a specified Immigration New Zealand application channel.
tests.basis: A present channel-specific payable amount belongs to current fee/charge information.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How an Immigration New Zealand internal administration circular instructs staff to handle a particular processing situation.
tests.basis: Trusted publication context identifies an INZ IAC rather than certified Manual content.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What an Immigration New Zealand Advice to Staff publication says about applying an operational procedure.
tests.basis: Trusted metadata identifies an Advice to Staff publication.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which steps an official Immigration New Zealand form guide directs applicants to follow when supplying supporting material.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes an INZ form/guide publication.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How a foreign civil registry requires a person to request a replacement birth certificate from that registry.
tests.basis: The foreign authority is acting in the role of issuer of the requested civil record.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What procedure a foreign police records office uses to issue an official police clearance certificate.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns obtaining a record from the foreign authority that issues it.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How a foreign passport authority requires a damaged passport to be replaced.
tests.basis: The responsible foreign authority is acting in a document-issuing role.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How a New Zealand government qualifications agency assesses whether an overseas qualification is comparable to a local one.
tests.basis: This is a non-professional external government assessment service.

tests.unsupported_proposition: How an external government identity agency verifies an official identity record through its own service.
tests.basis: The proposition concerns an administrative service owned by another official government agency.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which verification service a public records agency provides to confirm the authenticity of a document already issued.
tests.basis: The agency is providing a verification service rather than acting as the issuing authority for the requested document.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a person's immigration status makes them eligible for a publicly funded health service administered outside INZ.
tests.basis: This is an eligibility question within a separately administered public-service regime.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a temporary resident can access a government education subsidy administered by the education authority.
tests.basis: The authoritative home is the external public-service entitlement regime.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a person's current visa status qualifies them for a public housing service administered by another agency.
tests.basis: The proposition is about access to a separately administered public benefit.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which evidence a professional registration body requires when assessing overseas professional competence.
tests.basis: The authoritative owner is a professional registration body.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What clinical criteria an authorised medical assessor applies when completing a specialist fitness assessment.
tests.basis: The proposition belongs to a clinical/specialist assessor authority.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What standards an approved professional assessor uses to evaluate occupational competence.
tests.basis: The authoritative home is a professional assessment role.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which electronic arrival declaration system a foreign border authority requires travellers to use for its border process.
tests.basis: Trusted context establishes a generic foreign official operational owner, and the process is not document issuance.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What reporting procedure an overseas customs administration requires importers to use for its own customs operation.
tests.basis: Trusted context identifies a generic official operational owner and no more specific frozen external class applies.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether a recently announced immigration-related procedural change is already authoritative.
tests.basis: The proposition does not identify whether the change is a certified instruction, non-Manual publication, or another source, and no trusted context is supplied.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which official organisation controls an unspecified overseas clearance process.
tests.basis: The proposition does not establish whether the process is issuing, assessment, professional, entitlement, or another official role.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether an unnamed current service value found on an official website belongs to Immigration New Zealand or another agency.
tests.basis: The current-value semantics do not identify the authoritative owner.

tests.unsupported_proposition: What procedure an official overseas authority requires, where its operational role is not stated and no trusted source metadata is available.
tests.basis: Several external source classes remain plausible and the context-gated generic class cannot be established.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Whether an immigration-related fee mentioned in an undated secondary document is the current payable amount or only a historical legal reference.
tests.basis: The proposition does not establish whether it concerns a current charge value or legal/historical basis.

tests.unsupported_proposition: Which operational rule applies when a source description could refer either to certified immigration instructions or to an uncertified staff guidance document.
tests.basis: The source family is materially ambiguous and no trusted publication context resolves it.
